# Security Policy / 安全策略

## Supported Versions / 支持版本

| Version / 版本 | Supported / 是否支持 |
| -------------- | -------------------- |
| main (0.0.x)   | ✅                   |

## Reporting a Vulnerability / 报告漏洞

Please email security vulnerability reports to **a1317827282@gmail.com**. Do not disclose vulnerabilities through public issues, pull requests, or discussions.

请勿通过公开 Issue、Pull Request 或 Discussions 披露安全漏洞，请发送邮件至：**a1317827282@gmail.com**。

You will receive a confirmation reply after we receive your report. Please include a description of the vulnerability, steps to reproduce it, and the affected version so we can respond more quickly.

我们收到报告后会回复确认。请在邮件中附上漏洞描述、复现步骤与受影响版本，以便我们更快响应。
